AND d.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{driverName}, '%')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM driver_truck_type dtt_filter WHERE dtt_filter.driver_id = d.id AND dtt_filter.truck_type_id = #{truckTypeId} )
GROUP BY d.id ,d.create_time ORDER BY d.id
